supersedes: User explicitly rejected stone palette and generic navigation/layout; redesign requested.
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE radical, exceptionally art-directed desktop HERO for 8x social. This is a complete redesign, not a recolour of the previous generic warm-stone layout. 1600x1100 landscape, full website viewport without browser chrome. Bold enough to establish a company's visual identity, restrained enough to understand instantly. A premium contemporary campaign/editorial website for a creator-network company. Precision and strong composition, no UI kit.
References: image 1 supplies the approved five-person monochrome group portrait, preserve those same subjects and order as much as possible. Image 2 supplies the original serif 8x mark, keep the original shape. References are assets, NOT layout references.
STRICT PALETTE: deep carbon #121212 dominates, warm white #F5F4EF typography, vivid vermilion #FF4A24 as ONE decisive graphic area. No beige, stone, cream background, grey cards, gradients, multicolour or glass. Completely FLAT colour fields with sharp architectural geometry.
COMPOSITION:
Full dark carbon viewport. 64px outer margins. Header custom editorial masthead 100px tall. Original white serif '8x' with small white 'social' tightly alongside, left. On the far right one compact navigation line 'Brands' and 'Creators' with small slash separator, Brands active with tiny orange circle, then plenty of space and 'Let’s talk' followed by a solid white small CIRCLE containing black diagonal arrow. No five-link centered navigation, no pill outline CTA, no floating rounded navbar, no hamburger on desktop. A crisp subtle hairline spans under masthead. Everything feels designed, deliberate and unique.
Below header, huge expressive but highly legible light grotesk typography, tight kerning, three deliberate lines on left:
'Your brand.'
'A world'
'of voices.'
The type is NOT serif; approximately 150px at 1600px width, medium weight, smooth clean graphic letterforms, left aligned. Block spans x64 to~920, y155 to570. Headline is a strong editorial statement, NOT an eyebrow plus a generic centred title.
At upper-right, x1120 y205, much smaller but clear 22px white copy, approximately 280px wide:
'We build and manage'
'creator networks'
'for your brand.'
Below copy a white text CTA 'Build your network' beside a vermilion circular arrow button, normal accessible size 48px. No secondary button. Huge clear dark breathing space separating copy from main headline.
The LOWER 43% of viewport is ONE powerful monochrome five-person portrait panorama from reference1, faces naturally arranged across width with black clothes disappearing into carbon ground, showing all five heads, no clipped hair, no card borders, no individual tiles, no fake UI overlays, no repeated faces. Heads reach only up to below the headline, with NO text crossing eyes or mouths. Keep photorealistic detailed skin/hair. Upper left of image can gently overlap the empty space below type, but don't obscure words.
The one bold brand signature: a LARGE SOLID VERMILION DISK, about 420px diameter, behind the rightmost two people, offset toward right edge, visibly intersected by their black-and-white silhouettes. The disc is a flat print shape with a clean circular edge, not an orb, sphere, sunset, glow or gradient. Faces remain completely monochrome, orange only BEHIND them. This is the meaningful dot identity at architectural scale: people in front of one shared orange dot. Do not scatter orange dots or make a constellation.
At bottommost 35px, thin quiet line and ONLY a short delicate run of 12 tiny equal circular dots transitioning from warm white to orange on the far left; no caption, badges, chapters, stats or scrolling hints. The hero should be visually complete and sharply edited: distinctive masthead, massive confident headline, small offer/CTA, beautiful still photograph with a single bold disc. No additional text. This is an actual implementable website layout, not a poster with missing navigation.
AVOID all generic SaaS patterns, rounded bento cards, dashboards, floating content cards, product metrics, abstract ribbons, 3D logo repeats, particle clouds, fake reviews, pale corporate backgrounds, boilerplate centered hero composition. Keep hierarchy readable. It must look rich through composition, powerful portrait lighting and scale, NOT busy effects. High-end design magazine craft, slightly confrontational confidence, unforgettable yet minimal. Exact words clean and legible.
